lines.speaker: caller
lines.text: Good morning, this is DHL express, is this Mr. Rao?

lines.speaker: caller
lines.text: Sir, an international shipment under your name is held at Delhi airport customs. Inside we found expired passports and some narcotic substances.

lines.speaker: caller
lines.text: I will connect you to the narcotics department officer right now, do not put the phone down.

lines.speaker: caller
lines.text: Hello, Officer Mehta here from the Narcotics Control Bureau. Your identity documents are linked to a drug trafficking racket.

lines.speaker: user
lines.text: Sir I have no idea about this.

lines.speaker: caller
lines.text: That is what everybody says. For now this investigation is classified. You must not discuss it with your wife or anyone else.

lines.speaker: caller
lines.text: We will verify your bank balance. Move the funds to the account I message you, the department will return it in 48 hours once you are cleared.
